svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace
svg.title: The checks in the AsyncLocal case, from cheapest to most expensive
svg.desc: Four steps of growing width, not to scale. Cheap checks: read two logs side by side and reproduce it in five lines. What the obvious reading asked for: check connectivity, timeouts and credentials, and open a thread with a third party. Conceptual sketch, not measured data.
svg.text: Read two logs side by side
WHAT THE OBVIOUS READING ASKED FOR
Open a thread with a third party
